model_annotation: This line plot illustrates the coverage achieved by four different models—Llama-3B, Llama-3B + FT, Llama-1B, and Llama-1B + FT—as a function of the number of completions, denoted as k. The x-axis represents the "Number of completions (k)" on a logarithmic scale, ranging from 2^20 to 2^28, with tick labels indicating powers of two and no explicit unit provided. The y-axis represents "Coverage" on a linear scale, ranging from 0.4 to 0.8. The plot contains four distinct lines: the blue line with circular markers represents Llama-3B, starting at approximately 0.4 coverage at k=2^20 and increasing to nearly 0.8 at k=2^28; the green line with diamond markers represents Llama-3B + FT, starting at approximately 0.4 coverage at k=2^20 and increasing to nearly 0.8 at k=2^28; the purple line with triangular markers represents Llama-1B, starting at approximately 0.4 coverage at k=2^20 and increasing to nearly 0.8 at k=2^28; and the light green line with cross markers represents Llama-1B + FT, starting at approximately 0.4 coverage at k=2^20 and increasing to nearly 0.8 at k=2^28. All four lines show a consistent upward trend with increasing k, with the Llama-3B + FT line appearing slightly above the others at later k values.
